summary: The bad() entry point obtains a KeyGenerator for AES but never calls init() before generateKey(), which is the missing required cryptographic step (CWE-325). Without init(), the provider falls back to an implementation-default key size, which may be weaker than intended and leaves key strength unspecified. The fix adds an explicit keyGenerator.init(128) call so a 128-bit AES key is deterministically generated, preserving the encrypt-and-print feature for valid inputs.
